modules.name: Drift
modules.description: Analog-inspired voice with DCO, wavefolder, slope generator and contour envelope for organic melodic movement.

modules.name: Chrono
modules.description: Tape-style delay with drive, wow/flutter character and six head combinations for rhythmic echoes.

modules.name: Impact
modules.description: Drum synthesizer with Pure/Harsh engines, SNAP transient shaping, noise and punch controls.

modules.name: Chain
modules.description: Core stereo mixer for the Submit Chain, with pre gain, pan, two FX sends, HPF, mute and COMP/CV insert.

modules.name: Squeeze
modules.description: Sidechain envelope follower for the Submit Chain, designed to drive Chain's COMP/CV input.

modules.name: Shape
modules.description: Six-band SSL-style stereo EQ for the Submit Chain, designed for tone shaping after Chain.

modules.name: Master
modules.description: Final processor for the Submit Chain, with output level, transient, glue, width and limiting controls.

modules.name: Gain
modules.description: Line-level booster designed for MetaModule and external gear, with soft clipping, FX send and utility routing.

modules.name: Sweep
modules.description: DJ-style filter for the Submit Chain, with LP/HP sweep, resonance and momentary reset to center.

modules.name: Loop
modules.description: Sample loop player with waveform display, BPM detection, sync controls and stereo output.
